verdict.rationale: Jira's own marketing describes a built-in automation capability: custom automation rules that move work forward, automated reminders, and automation that keeps Jira up to date from connected tools. That covers event-driven routine work. However, no evidence explicitly documents a schedule-based trigger or how recurring rules are configured. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled triggers (cron or interval), detail on recurring-event trigger types and rule configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Use Rovo AI to create custom automations to keep your status up to date - from automated reminders to rules that move work forward.
Whether your team is using Bitbucket, Slack, or any other tool, automation keeps Jira up to date, so you don't have to.
Connect your tools to any Jira workflow with automation.
